text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... Just one more step, 
and I would've had it...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Still... I can't let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If you're saying I can't reach victory 
like this... then I'll close that gap with 
my own hard work!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
First, we gotta rethink my training! I 
need to make up for what I'm lacking!

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll show you I can do it! ...Putting 
in the effort is what matters most, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Those who work earnestly and honestly are 
the ones who get to take center stage... 
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will not slack off. Because 
that is the proper path to reaching my 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There is much to be learned from 
defeat, after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter what caused the defeat, if we 
patiently face it... we will surely be 
able to overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I won't let this defeat go to waste. I 
will become stronger... without fail!
